changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.44
- The app icon can now be customized too (pick "App Icon" in Settings > Overlay Details > Custom icon). Custom app icons draw full-color as-is.
- Custom port/module icons now render in the built-in monochrome style: the app keeps your image's shape and tints it to your accent color (dim when inactive), so a transparent-PNG silhouette looks just like the stock icons. Best input is a transparent PNG.
